messages.content:
Risk: Inadequate AI literacy and communication
Description: The AI system's capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use cases may be insufficiently understood or communicated within the organization, potentially resulting in ineffective implementation or failure to achieve desired outcomes.
Concern: None
Policy: Acceptable AI Use Cases

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0000246: obsolete: behavior AE — a behavioral AE that results in uncharacteristic behaviors [found by 5/9 queries]
  Siblings: obsolete: reflexes decreased AE, thrombocythemia AE - OBSOLETE (due to duplication), obsolete: medical device adverse event
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0004801: automatism AE — This is an AE which refers to a set of brief unconscious behaviors. [found by 4/9 queries]
  Siblings: somnambulism AE, attention-seeking behaviour AE, somatoform disorder AE
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 7/9 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/Agent: agent — something autonomous that can adapt to and interact with its environment [found by 6/9 queries]
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000089: Skill — An Agent Capability that inheres in a Person to the extent of that Person's capacity to realize it in Intentional Acts of a certain type. [found by 6/9 queries]
  Siblings: Organization Capability
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001262: Person — An Animal that is a member of the species Homo sapiens. [from restriction: ont00001889 on ont00000089]
  Siblings: person, organisation, legal person
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001379: Agent Capability — A Realizable Entity that inheres in a Material Entity in virtue of that Material Entity's capacity to realize it in some Planned Act. [from equivalence]
  Siblings: Strength, Affordance, plan

axes.rationale: The risk centers on 'inadequate AI literacy,' which is a deficiency in the skills or capabilities required to understand and use AI. This axis allows for variation in the specific types of skills (e.g., technical literacy vs. ethical understanding) that are lacking.

The risk involves individuals within an organization failing to understand or communicate AI capabilities. This axis allows for variation in the type of person affected (e.g., end-users, developers, or decision-makers).

The risk is specifically about the misunderstanding of 'AI systems.' Using this class allows for variation in the complexity or type of AI entity being discussed (e.g., a simple chatbot vs. an autonomous agent).
